key_concepts: Roots anchor plants and absorb water and nutrients from soil
Stems transport water and nutrients and support leaves and flowers
Leaves make food through photosynthesis using light, air, and water
Flowers are the reproductive part that develops into fruit
Fruits contain seeds that can grow into new plants
Plants provide wood for houses, furniture, pencils, and toys
Paper is an important product made from plants
Plants give fruits and vegetables that can be food and medicine
Trees and plants produce oxygen and fresh air
Plant roots help prevent floods and soil erosion
Plants provide shade and shelter for animals
Some plant parts are used for decoration, food wrapping, roofing, and transport
